description: This file is a shell script designed for testing various scenarios with 'marks' in a Git repository. It includes setup steps for dumping repository history, creating large marks files, importing with marks, handling submodules, and testing relative paths. The script uses Git commands and test helper functions to perform these actions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided shell commands.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified content, used in setup tests.

methods.name: test_seq
methods.description: Generates a sequence of numbers used for creating large marks.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a specified path is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a specified path does not exist.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files.
